title: Files
empty: No running container mounts this PVC. Create a browsing pod to open its files.
unavailable: This container is not running. Choose another mount or create a browsing pod.
blocked: Block volumes do not contain a browsable filesystem.
claimUnavailable: This PVC is being deleted or has lost its volume.
singlePod: This ReadWriteOncePod volume is already used by a pod. Use an existing mount; a second pod cannot mount it until the current consumer is removed.
openFailed: Cannot browse this mount. Choose another container or create a browsing pod with file utilities.
createDescription: Mount this PVC at /volume in a temporary pod. The pod stays available until you remove it using the cleanup action below.
imageHint: The image must provide sleep, ls --full-time, cat, tar, test, and tee.
sameNode: The browsing pod will use the same node as the existing consumer: {{node}}.
pending: Waiting for the browsing pod to start…
cleanupNote: Only this plugin's browsing pod will be deleted. The PVC and its files will remain.
helperStopped: The browsing pod has stopped. Remove it before creating another.
